findings.issue: Wave/depends_on ordering violation: task 6 has `wave: 2` and `depends_on: [1, 3]`, but task 3 is also `wave: 2`. Per validator rule, a task with depends_on:[X] must have wave > wave of task X. Tasks in the same wave run in parallel, so task 6 cannot depend on task 3 unless task 3 is in an earlier wave.
findings.fix: Either (a) move task 6 to `wave: 3` (clean dependency on task 3 finishing) — but this delays the TelegramSender hook unnecessarily; OR (b) keep wave 2 but soften the dependency: drop `3` from `depends_on` (task 6 only needs the interface signature, which is part of Task 1's `SubscriberService.java` extension contract — task 6's own Details narrative already states 'Task 6 only depends on the INTERFACE methods existing; runtime wiring is exercised by Task 3'). Recommended (b): change `depends_on: [1, 3]` → `depends_on: [1]` and document the interface-only coupling in task 3 as a 'producer of the interface signature consumed by task 6 in parallel'.

findings.issue: Skill link path is relative without prefix: `[skills/code-writing/SKILL.md](.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md)`. Resolving from `work/09-subscribers/tasks/` would lookup `work/09-subscribers/tasks/.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md`, which does not exist. Tasks 6, 7, 9 use the correct `../../../.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md` prefix.
findings.fix: Change the link target to `../../../.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md` to match the established pattern in tasks 6/7/9 and resolve correctly from the task file's directory.

summary: Batch 2 (tasks 6-10) is largely solid: section structure, frontmatter, reviewer paths, AC/TDD carry-forward, and shared-resource consumer wiring all check out. Three issues found: (1) CRITICAL — task 6 declares `depends_on: [1, 3]` while running in the same wave (wave 2) as task 3, violating wave-ordering invariant; recommend dropping `3` from depends_on (task 6's own narrative documents interface-only coupling) or moving task 6 to wave 3. (2) MINOR — task 8 Required Skills link uses `.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md` instead of `../../../.claude/skills/code-writing/SKILL.md` and won't resolve from the task file. (3) MINOR — task 10 has the same skill-link issue. Tasks 7 and 9 are approved as-is.
